name: Vedalken
description: A tall, thin, hairless, blue-skinned humanoid race of exceptional mental acumen, natural artificers and mages, found on many planes.

timeline.summary: The Neurok use the Litera Phials to learn how to destroy vedalken drones.
timeline.quote: even learning the secret to destroy a key vedalken weapon

citation.text: "Neurok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of the Synod the Neurok power down the vedalken drones and defeat the Synod.
timeline.quote: The Synod was defeated, but hundreds died on both sides.

citation.text: "Neurok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Neurok and Vedalken leaders agree to an uneasy truce.
timeline.quote: Leaders between the Neurok and the Vedalken reached an uneasy truce.

citation.text: "Neurok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Mirrodin, the mycosynth's vapor mutates the vedalken, who develop four arms and gills.
timeline.quote: the mycosynth created a vapor that induced mutations in the vedalken

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Memnarch's fall, the Synod reorganizes the vedalken into sanctives, and Neurok revolts force cooperation.
timeline.quote: revolts from the Neurok forced the two races into a state of cooperation rather than subservience

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When New Phyrexia rises, Jin-Gitaxias overtakes Lumengrid and turns conquered vedalken into a research library.
timeline.quote: Lumengrid was overtaken by the forces of Jin-Gitaxias

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Memnarch grants the vedalken a touch of his power in exchange for service, creating a debt.
timeline.quote: Memnarch shared a touch of his power with the vedalken in return for their service.

citation.text: Synod Artificer (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: With Janus dead, Pontifex ascends to leadership of the Synod.
timeline.quote: With Janus dead, Pontifex has ascended to the leadership of the Synod.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Pontifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orland orchestrates a vote returning the Vedalken Empire to a Republic and Pontifex is stripped of power.
timeline.quote: Pontifex arrives and learns Orland has orchestrated a vote to return the Vedalken Empire to a Republic.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Pontifex versus the Synod". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pontifex kills two of his former Synod council members and leaves swearing vengeance.
timeline.quote: Orland dodges, but the other two are killed.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Pontifex versus the Synod". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Auriok salvagers gather scraps left by Memnarch and the vedalken.
timeline.quote: Memnarch or the vedalken salvage most of the large machines, leaving us only scraps.

citation.text: Auriok Salvagers (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Shards of Alara realigned, some vedalken migrated from Esper to Naya.
timeline.quote: some migrated to Naya after the Shards of Alara realigned

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Conflux, red and green mana flood Esper and its hegemony begins to fall apart.
timeline.quote: When the Conflux happened, red and green mana flooded into Esper.

citation.text: "Esper", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Alara was reborn, vedalken heretics from Esper reject etherium for nature in the jungles of Naya.
timeline.quote: they rejected the cold clutch of etherium in favor of the warm embrace of nature

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Nayan Vedalken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The vedalken and Neurok struggle for power, and many casualties simply disappear.
timeline.quote: Most casualties of the power struggle between vedalken and Neurok didn't die on the field of battle

citation.text: Disperse (Scars of Mirrodin, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Neurok and vedalken leaders reach an uneasy truce, trading serum for knowledge.
timeline.quote: Leaders between the Neurok and the vedalken reached an uneasy truce.

citation.text: "The Human Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Nov 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Memnarch falls, solidifying vedalken rule and prompting unchecked vedalken experimentation.
timeline.quote: Vedalken rule was solidified by the fall of Memnarch.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The vedalken form the seven Sanctives to control knowledge.
timeline.quote: For this purpose the seven Sanctives were formed.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vedalken experiments devastate the blinkmoth population, making serum extremely rare.
timeline.quote: This myopic and uncontrolled research soon made blinkmoths, and thus serum, among the rarest commodities on Mirrodin.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Knowledge Pool destabilizes and goes insane, a secret the vedalken keep even through the Synod's fall.
timeline.quote: quickly went insane.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grgur devises the Meldweb from will-stripped compleated vedalken.
timeline.quote: A subpraetor named Grgur devised the Meldweb to remedy this problem.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The remaining vedalken and Neurok bond together for survival.
timeline.quote: the scant remaining vedalken and Neurok have bonded together for survival.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vronos finds himself among the Ethersworn vedalken, who first judge him imperfect and then value him as a new planeswalker.
timeline.quote: This one might be of value.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of their intelligence.
timeline.quote: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

citation.text: Silver Myr (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vedalken experiments caused a sharp decline in blinkmoths, called the Diminishing.
timeline.quote: This was called the "Diminishing".

citation.text: "Blinkmoth", section "Blinkmoth serum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of the Synod the Neurok use stolen information to disable the vedalken drone defenses.
timeline.quote: the Neurok used information stolen from vedalken libraries to disable their wanderguard and hoverguard defenses

citation.text: "Drone", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of the Synod the Neurok disable vedalken defenses, leaving hundreds dead including vedalken leadership.
timeline.quote: the Neurok were able to disable vedalken defenses at Lumengrid, leading to a massive battle

citation.text: "Lumengrid", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The two cultures enter an uneasy truce, vedalken in the upper city and Neurok in the lower.
timeline.quote: the two cultures entered an uneasy truce, in which both inhabited Lumengrid.

citation.text: "Lumengrid", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Annul (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
